body: It’s avery scary thing to say, “I want to he Free.” It can be very terrifying. It means that the ground from under you can fall away at any moment. It just came out by itself. Irealized IhadtTt been thinking about it. Isaid again, “I’m ready to die but Idon’t hiow how.” This was areal declaration of death.
